title: The sharp one-dimensional convex sub-Gaussian comparison constant
summary: Let $X$ be an integrable real random variable with mean zero and two-sided sub-Gaussian tail $\mathbb{P}(|X|>t)\le 2e^{-t^{2}/2}$ for all $t\ge 0$. We determine the smallest constant $c_\star$ such that $X$ is dominated in convex order by $c_\star G$, where $G$ is standard normal. Equivalently, $c_\star^2$ is the sharp one-dimensional convex sub-Gaussian comparison constant appearing in the \emph{Optimization Constants in Mathematics} repository~\cite{optimization-constants-repo}.
